create_root_inv_shampoo_preconditioner: create a RootInvShampooPreconditionerList to precondition gradients using matrix inverse root computation for a list of parameters
create_eigendecomposed_shampoo_precondit: create an EigendecomposedShampooPreconditionerList to precondition gradients using eigendecomposition of factor matrices for a list of parameters
create_eigenvalue_corrected_shampoo_prec: create an EigenvalueCorrectedShampooPreconditionerList to precondition gradients using corrected eigenvalues and eigenvectors for a list of parameters
update_shampoo_preconditioners: call update_preconditioners on a BaseShampooPreconditionerList to update Kronecker factor matrices and optionally perform amortized computation
precondition_gradients_with_shampoo: call precondition on a ShampooPreconditionerList to compute preconditioned gradients from a list of masked gradient tensors
